title: Molecular docking analysis of p53 with Toll-like receptors.
authors: Alam, Mohammad Jahoor; Bardakci, Fevzi; Anjum, Sadia; Mir, Shumayla Rasheed; Ahmad, Irfan; Saeed, Mohd
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接分析p53与Toll样受体的相互作用，虽涉及转录因子p53，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA，且无AI或MD模拟，仅初步对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: P53 is one of the most important proteins for its role in cellular signal transduction pathways. It regulates a wide variety of cellular processes, which includes apoptosis, senescence, cell cycle arrest, differentiation, and DNA repair and replication and cancer dynamics. It is a transcription factor for various cellular proteins. Recent report suggests that P53 is linked with transduction proteins involved in cellular immunity. Toll like receptors are needed for communication in cellular immunity. The interaction between p53 and toll like receptors is reported in various studies. Therefore, it is of interest to document the molecular docking analysis of p53 with Toll-like receptors for further consideration in therapeutic development. In the present paper we studied molecular interaction between p53 and toll like receptors using molecular docking approach. We used open-source tools for molecular docking and analyzing the data. Our molecular docking results suggest there is a promising interaction between p53 and toll like receptors. Our study will be a very useful for molecular therapeutics and drug design strategies. Further, molecular dynamics studies can be useful to determine of the stability of complex form by p53 and toll like receptors.
abstract_zh: P53因其在细胞信号转导通路中的作用而成为最重要的蛋白质之一。它调控多种细胞过程，包括细胞凋亡、衰老、细胞周期阻滞、分化、DNA修复与复制以及癌症动态。它是多种细胞蛋白的转录因子。近期报告表明，P53与参与细胞免疫的转导蛋白相关联。Toll样受体在细胞免疫通讯中是必需的。多项研究报告了p53与Toll样受体之间的相互作用。因此，记录p53与Toll样受体的分子对接分析以供治疗开发进一步考虑具有重要意义。在本论文中，我们使用分子对接方法研究了p53与Toll样受体之间的分子相互作用。我们使用开源工具进行分子对接和数据分析。我们的分子对接结果表明p53与Toll样受体之间存在有前景的相互作用。我们的研究将对分子治疗学和药物设计策略非常有用。此外，分子动力学研究可用于确定p53与Toll样受体形成复合物的稳定性。
